paragraphs.text: Syr Joshua , the Beast Tamer , and Syr Saxon are a pair of human knights and lovers from Eldraine .

Syr Joshua is an Ardenvale knight and Syr Saxon is a ranger of generous heart from Eldraine. The two are lovers who fight together and are companions of Rowan Kenrith . Syr Joshua carries a warhammer while Syr Saxon carries a bone axe. They were both victims of the Wicked Slumber .
